name: Basic Biomedical Laboratory
description: Students shall be introduced to practical training through biomedical engineering experiments. The course will consist of modules studying the role of bioelectronics, biomaterials, biomaging, and biomechanics in biomedical engineering. Bioelectronics: Basic electronic design and interfacing, laboratory exercises on bioinstrumentation. Biomaterials: materials synthesis, characterization and modification of various biomaterials. Bioimaging: The role of medical imaging and signal processing in biomedical engineering. Biomechanics: Biomedical implant design, fabrication and printing, gait, the mechanical properties of tissues.
